magnifier.caption_help: The caption is a short text for this cut-out, for example a line printed below the image. For a file note from Commons it is the text of that note. You see it in the object list and in the tooltip on the image, and it is included in the export. 'What is this?' gets it as help (another caption is a new question). In the Commons draft you can use it as the caption or add it to the description with one click; as long as there is no description yet, it serves as the Dutch description there. It does not go to Commons as a separate field.

rights_help.in_orde: Public domain or a free licence, without trademark, personality rights, deletion request or pending licence review. Cut-outs may be uploaded.
